profile.headline: Software Engineer at UKG
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 10 years of hands-on experience in the software industry and a passion for problem-solving.
Strong MS SQL and relational databases skills with emphasis on reporting tools and data warehouse.
Years of experience developing and troubleshooting complex SQL queries and troubleshooting queries performance.
Strong software testing skills.
Strong understanding of object-oriented concepts and experience working with C#.Net, REST APIs, Java, Domain-driven design, Event Sourcing patterns.
More than 7 years working in a software company using strict standards for quality, performance, and security, which directly translate to customer satisfaction and a great user experience.
Some experience with front-end and Angular web development, Typescript, HTML, CSS.
Accustomed to working with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment practices in large teams and the coordination that it entails.
Well used to working in an Agile methodology using Kanban to deliver functionality and value fast and consistently.

Skills, tools, and technologies:

Relational DBs, NoSQL MongoDB
MS SQL queries and performance
DataVault/DataMart, Data warehousing
Reporting tools, SSRS, Cognos, DevExpress
ETL

C#.NET, VB.NET
Java
Typescript
REST APIs
Entity Framework
Domain-driven design
Event Sourcing
Container Technologies, Docker
Object-Oriented Programming

Software testing
Unit, Integration, PRS testing
Blackbox and Whitebox testing

GIT, SVN version control
RabbitMQ
Continuous Integration and Deployment

Agile Kanban methodology
Fluent in English and Spanish

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Development and maintenance of the company's ERP System developed in house using VB.NET for the front end and T-SQL for the back end logic.
